title: The Entrepreneurial Mindset — Strategy, Motivation & Risk
tagline: In Tampa Bay waters, clarity is survival.
summary: Entrepreneurial performance is dictated by psychological positioning. A founder's default motivational focus determines how they perceive every goal, threat, and opportunity. Read the market currents with the precision of an apex predator.

learningObjectives.statement: Diagnose your own default motivational focus (promotion vs. prevention) and select the complementary safeguard that offsets its characteristic failure mode.
Distinguish zero-sum from collaborative interactions in a given business scenario and choose a strategy appropriate to the structure.
Evaluate a negotiation or decision by separating stated positions from underlying interests, and judge whether the actor is pursuing a win or avoiding a loss.

activities.title: Promotion vs. Prevention focus — theory & founder examples
Name one decision each lens would handle differently
Classify three deal scenarios by structure
Apex Mentor probes your strategy choice
Positions vs. interests; the $12,000 vs. quick-close example
Strategy checklist applied to a personal goal

assessments.method: Scored diagnostic + written rationale identifying the learner's focus and chosen safeguard
assessments.successCriteria: Correctly identifies dominant focus and names a specific, relevant safeguard.

assessments.method: Scenario classification: label 4 interactions as zero-sum or collaborative with justification
assessments.successCriteria: At least 3 of 4 correctly classified with a one-sentence structural justification each.

assessments.method: Short written analysis separating positions from interests in a provided negotiation transcript
assessments.successCriteria: Identifies at least two positions and the interest beneath each; states whether the actor is winning or not-losing.
